changes: original_meaning 按古英语 þus 的 gloss 收为「如此，以这种方式」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 写明方式义滑出因果义的机制（并以荷兰语同源词 dus 至今兼二义为旁证）；该因果义在三套缓存中无首见年代，period 按标准标「来源未注年代」。
evidence: Etymonline: "thus (adv.) \"in the manner or state being indicated,\" from Old English þus \"in this way, as follows,\" related to þæt \"that\" and this; from Proto-Germanic *thus- (source also of Old Saxon and Old Frisian thus, Middle Dutch and Dutch dus)."
Wiktionary: "from Old English þus 'thus, in this way, as follows, in this manner, to this extent'... Cognate with Dutch dus 'thus, so'."
thus.mechanism_sentence: thus 与 this、that 同族，古英语 þus 只说「以这种方式」：话讲到推理处，「照这样」自然滑成「因此」——荷兰语的亲戚 dus 到今天还兼着方式与因果两个意思。

semantic_path.how: 方式滑向了因果：『照这个样子（往下推）』在推理语境里被读作『既然如此、由此得出』——thus 担起了结论标记的活（银行今义『因此；从而』即此）。荷兰语同源词 dus 今天仍是方式、因果二义同体，可见这一步滑动是这族词的共同老路。

changes: original_meaning 大改：现行字段取的是古英语晚期才有的『建材』义；Etymonline 明言 timber 在古英语『originally \"building, structure\"』，按此改原义为「建筑，建筑物」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 写明产物→材料的转喻与德语 Zimmer 的同源分化事实。
evidence: Etymonline: "from Old English timber, originally \"building, structure,\" in late Old English \"building material, growing trees yielding wood suitable for building,\" and by extension \"trees or woods in general.\" This is reconstructed to be from Proto-Germanic *tem(b)ra-... according to Watkins from PIE *deme- \"to build,\" possibly a form of the root *dem- meaning \"house, household\" (source of Greek domos, Latin domus)."
Etymonline: "timber (v.) Old English timbran, timbrian, \"to build,\" verb from the source of timber (n.). It was the chief Old English word for \"to build,\" but now is obsolete in this sense."
Oxford: "Old English in the sense 'a building', also 'building material'... related to German Zimmer 'room', from an Indo-European root meaning 'build'."
timber.mechanism_sentence: timber 最初是「建筑物」本身（与拉丁语 domus「家」同根）：从建好的房子滑到建房子用的木头，就成了「木材」；它的德语亲戚 Zimmer 守住了屋子那头，至今是「房间」。

semantic_path.how: 从产物滑到材料（转喻）：古英语晚期 timber 转指『能作建材的木材、林木』，此后定型为『木材，木料』（词库今义）；同根的德语 Zimmer 走的是另一支——始终指屋子、房间。

changes: original_meaning 前溯到通俗拉丁语 *toccare/古法语 tochier 的 gloss「敲，击」：现行路径把今义『触摸』当作原义，掩盖了敲→摸这一步关键滑动（OED 有专门说明）。
semantic_path 按 Etymonline 编年重建三站（敲击 → 约 1300 年触摸 → 14 世纪中感动）。
mechanism_sentence 重写（原句为浅述式）。
evidence: Etymonline: "touch (v.) c. 1300, touchen, \"move or reach so as to make deliberate physical contact with...\" from Old French tochier \"to touch, hit, knock; mention, deal with\" (11c.), from Vulgar Latin *toccare \"to knock, strike\" as a bell... a word perhaps of imitative origin."
Etymonline: "The passage of the sense 'knock, strike' into that of 'touch' (in Fr., etc.) is like that of Eng. 'thrust, push' into 'put': a stroke at its lightest is a mere touch. [OED, 1989]"
Etymonline: "The sense of \"affect or move mentally, emotionally, or morally, affect with feeling or emotion\" is by mid-14c., with a notion of \"touching\" the heart or mind."
touch.mechanism_sentence: touch 的老底是「敲」（*toccare 敲钟，疑为拟声词）：击打轻到极点，就成了触摸——约 1300 年它入英语管「摸」，14 世纪中又摸到了心上，管起了「感动」。

semantic_path.how: OED 点破了这一步：击打减到最轻，就是一次接触——tochier 的敲义在法语里滑成摸义；英语约 1300 年入词时，touch 已是『有意把手放上去接触、感知』，词库今义即此。
手指摸到了心上：14 世纪中 touch 添『触动情感、使动容』义——话语、遭遇能像接触一样直接碰到人的心，这个比喻义从此与字面义并行。

changes: original_meaning 按古英语 tōh 的 gloss 收为「坚韧的；抓得牢的」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 按 Etymonline 编年（14 世纪初难嚼、难忍 → 1610 年代难做定型）替换套话；词根与『咬』的关系是 Watkins 的推测，只写入 changes 不入正文路径。
evidence: Etymonline: "Old English toh \"strong and firm in texture, flexible without being brittle; tenacious, sticky, not easily separated;\" from Proto-Germanic *tanhu-..., which Watkins suggests is from PIE *denk- \"to bite,\" on the notion of \"holding fast.\""

Etymonline: "It is attested from c. 1200 as \"strong, powerful\"... and early 14c. as \"difficult to chew,\" also \"hard to endure.\"... that of \"hard to do, requiring great or continued effort, laborious\" is from 1610s."
tough.mechanism_sentence: tough 是古英语 tōh「结实柔韧、黏着不放」：先说东西的质地（嚼不动的肉），14 世纪起说事难忍，1610 年代定型为「艰难的」——对付不了的质地，变成了对付不了的事情。

semantic_path.how: 从质地滑到难度：14 世纪初 tough 已兼指肉『难嚼』和事『难忍』，1610 年代『难做、费力』义定型——词库『艰难的』与首站『坚韧的』是同一枚硬币的两面：它硬，所以你难。
